identity.name: Drawlead Construction ERP
identity.tone: Calm, precise, brand-led (Drawlead green on black & white)
principles: One brand colour (#31B46E) for actions, selection and focus; status colours only carry meaning
Secondary is black & white: black buttons, avatars and hero tiles in light mode (white in dark mode)
Generous radii (cards rounded-2xl, hero tiles rounded-3xl), hairline borders, near-flat shadows
Data is the hero: tabular figures, uppercase letter-spaced labels and table heads, airy rows
White icon-rail shell (expandable), large page title with an uppercase eyebrow, light canvas content

typography.secondary_font: Plus Jakarta Sans (Inter as glyph fallback)
typography.mono_font: Plus Jakarta Sans (font-mono = UI face with tabular-nums slashed-zero)

scale.h1: text-[22px]–text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight (page title in AppHeader)

scales.brand: brand-50…950 (500 = #31B46E); green and emerald alias brand
scales.ink: ink-50…950 true neutral gray; gray and slate alias ink

colors.gradients: none on surfaces — exceptions: the dark hero tile may carry one soft blurred brand glow

shell.desktop: Fixed white sidebar: 5.5rem icon rail by default (tooltips, green logo tile, light-green active tile, black avatar + logout at the foot), expandable to 15rem with labels; sticky 76px top bar with eyebrow (role/module · Financial Year) and page title
shell.mobile: Top bar with hamburger drawer + MobileBottomNav

buttons.primary: <Button> default: bg-primary text-white font-semibold shadow-sm hover:bg-primary-hover; add shadow-brand for the green glow on hero CTAs
buttons.secondary: variant="secondary": black bg, white text (inverts in dark mode)

cards.kpi_tile: <SummaryCard tone=positive|negative|warning|neutral>: uppercase label, tinted icon chip top-right, large figure, coloured sub-line
cards.hero_tile: rounded-3xl bg-[#0B0B0C] text-white with one blurred bg-primary/25 glow (Executive Balance)

inputs.base: h-9 rounded-lg border-input bg-background shadow-xs hover:border-ink-300 focus-visible:border-primary focus-visible:ring-4 focus-visible:ring-ring/15

tabs.segmented: TabsList h-11 rounded-2xl border bg-muted/80 p-1; active trigger rounded-xl bg-background shadow
tabs.underline: border-b-2 border-primary text-primary-strong font-semibold, items spaced gap-5/gap-7

tables.head: h-11 px-4 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground, no fill

badges.solid: <Badge> default (solid green; call sites pass their own bg-*)
badges.soft: variant soft|warning|danger|info: pale tint + matching -200 border

visual_enhancers.shadows: tailwind shadow-xs…2xl (neutral black), shadow-brand for the green glow on primary buttons and the logo tile

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME: tokens live in frontend/src/index.css (:root/.dark) and tailwind.config.js — never hard-code the brand hex in pages; use bg-primary / text-primary-strong / brand-*.
2. FONT: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter as glyph fallback (both loaded in public/index.html).
3. ACTIONS: primary actions use the default <Button>; destructive stays red; avoid per-page rainbow button colours.
4. STATUS COLOURS: amber = pending/warning, red = error/rejected, green = done/income; categorical chips may use other hues as pale tints.
5. NAVIGATION: AppHeader renders the sidebar + top bar; pages only pass customNav/headerActions/backTo/hideNav.
6. MOBILE FIRST: stack forms/dashboards on mobile; large touch targets on site flows.
7. DATA-TESTID: add data-testid to every interactive element.
universal_guidelines: Flat tints and black/white tiles; the only gradient is the soft brand glow on dark hero tiles.
Selected/active state = brand green (tint or solid).
Respect dark mode: prefer tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border) over raw white/gray.
